historical_record.description: The Recreation Commission awarded one $842,000 contract to Carrico & Gautier to build four recreation centers: Potrero Hill, Ocean View, St. Mary's and Sunset.
Potrero Hill Playground, 22nd and Arkansas Streets, was dedicated, according to the official list of 1947 recreation bond playgrounds the Recreation and Park Commission entered in its minutes.
The Recreation Commission contracted with architect William G. Merchant, for $7,680, to furnish plans for a field house at Potrero Hill Playground.
The Playground Commission, buying the 9.55-acre Potrero Hill site since 1926, bought more of it for $8,552.25 ($37,074.25 in land so far) and was improving the rocky point by cut and fill.
The Playground Commission made the final payment on the Potrero Hill Playground site.
